gym_info.name: Titan Fitness Club
gym_info.description: Titan Fitness Club is a full-service strength, cardio, and wellness center offering personalized programs, professional trainers, and cutting-edge equipment. We focus on building better bodies through science, discipline, and community.

policies.cancellation: Membership cancellations require a 14-day notice before the next billing cycle.
policies.dress_code: Closed-toe shoes and athletic wear required.
policies.guest_pass: Members can bring one guest per month free of charge.
policies.age_policy: Members must be 16 or older. Under 18 require parental consent.

basic.description: Perfect for casual gym-goers who want basic access to all main workout areas.

perks: Access to all group fitness classes
premium.description: For dedicated members looking for a full fitness experience.

elite.description: For athletes and professionals who want full access and premium perks.

student.description: Affordable access for students with valid ID.

trainers.name: Alex Torres
trainers.bio: Alex focuses on muscle building, powerlifting techniques, and sustainable strength programming.

trainers.name: Maya Lee
trainers.bio: Maya designs high-intensity functional programs tailored for busy professionals.

trainers.name: Dr. Ryan Patel
trainers.bio: Ryan helps clients recover from injuries and improve flexibility through science-based rehab.

weight_loss.goal: Reduce body fat and improve endurance
weight_loss.diet_guide: High protein, low refined carbs, caloric deficit meal plan

muscle_gain.goal: Increase lean muscle mass and strength
muscle_gain.diet_guide: Caloric surplus with high protein intake and balanced macros

rehab.goal: Recover from injuries and restore mobility

policies.rescheduling: Free reschedule up to 24 hours before appointment.

events.name: Summer Shred Challenge
events.description: 12-week transformation competition with prizes for top 3 results.

events.name: Free Nutrition Workshop
events.description: Learn the science of fat loss and metabolism with Dr. Ryan Patel.

current_offers.title: Bring a Friend
current_offers.details: Refer a friend and get one month free!

faq.question: Do I need to book before visiting?
faq.answer: Walk-ins are welcome, but booking ensures equipment availability.

faq.question: Do you offer personal training?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer 1-on-1 and small group sessions.

faq.question: Is there parking available?
faq.answer: Yes, free parking for all members.

faq.question: Can I freeze my membership?
faq.answer: Yes, for up to 3 months per year with written notice.

testimonials.name: Sarah Johnson
testimonials.feedback: The trainers and support at Titan Fitness changed my life!

testimonials.name: Mark Daniels
testimonials.feedback: The structured programs and equipment variety are unmatched.
